from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path.cwd()
directory=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_coupon_jan2024_source_qualification_v1'
assert not directory.exists(),'本来源实验目录已经存在，不能覆盖重跑'
directory.mkdir()
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
fields=['cusip','security_type','security_term','original_security_term','auction_date','issue_date','maturity_date','announcemt_date','offering_amt','xml_filenm_announcemt','pdf_filenm_announcemt','floating_rate','inflation_index_security','reopening','original_issue_date']
protocol={
 'study_id':'510300_TREASURY_COUPON_JAN2024_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1',
 'experiment_id':'E4_COUPON_SOURCE',
 'registered_at':stamp,
 'phase':'FIXED_MONTH_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_NO_STOCK_RETURNS',
 'question':'2024年1月常规固定利率Note/Bond逐次公告规模、时钟与新发续发是否明确，是否已经由2023年11月季度安排提前披露？',
 'scope':{'auction_month':'2024-01','security_types':['Note','Bond'],'exclude':['Bill','TIPS','FRN'],'selection_independent_of_stock_returns':True},
 'prior_search_disclosure':'注册前已搜索到2023-11-01季度安排描述将覆盖2024-01；尚未读取本月coupon各券API金额或新收益，不能把季度预告存在当作新发现。',
 'api':{'url':'https://api.fiscaldata.treasury.gov/services/api/fiscal_service/v1/accounting/od/auctions_query','filter':'auction_date:gte:2024-01-01,auction_date:lte:2024-01-31','fields':fields,'sort':'auction_date,cusip','page_size':200,'max_pages':2,'reason':'一次覆盖固定月，只取公告/券类字段，直接排除拍卖后结果。'},
 'announcement_originals':{'sample_rule':'全部符合范围coupon各券原XML/PDF，重复文件仅取一次','max_securities':12,'max_original_files':24,'max_concurrent_requests':3,'attempts_per_url':2,'no_retry_on_403_429':True},
 'quarterly_prior_source':{'date':'2023-11-01','url':'https://home.treasury.gov/news/press-releases/jy1864','role':'实际财政部预定规模；TBAC建议不得代替财政部安排','clock_context_optional_url':'https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/USTREAS/bulletins/378754d?reqfrom=share','max_extra_sources':3},
 'allowlist':fields,
 'future_outcome_fields_excluded':'不请求拍卖利率、投标/获配、成交价格、SOMA/FIMA成交、record_date或修订后净现金字段。',
 'comparisons':['所有合格券原PDF与API/XML规模和公布日/时刻一致','新发续发、原期限/剩余期限分别保存','按11月季度计划比较1月每个原期限规模；无计划或无原件不填0','同刻多券去重为公告根；逐次规模无变化时不称新意外'],
 'source_admission_gate':'金额/单位/当时原文时钟/范围齐备，只支持有限历史重建；季度提前计划若已覆盖逐次金额，逐次金额意外表达不注册评分。',
 'not_required':'不认证当年采集运行，不等待未来发布，不开展五/十年全库检验；历史首版未认证如实保留。',
 'continuation_if_all_preannounced':'接受上游季度供给安排事实，下一项优先定义真正季度原因更新及同池控制；不把日历再公告复制成高频冲击。',
 'research_limits':{'new_model_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_price_or_stock_returns_loaded':False,'new_repository_code_edits':0,'goal_achieved':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False},
}
p=directory/'protocol.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
inputs=[
 'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/protocol.json',
 'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/result.json',
 'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/announcement_pdf_unit_clock_check.json',
 'reports/research/510300_treasury_auction_announcement_source_probe_v1/next_source_question.json',
 'reports/research/510300_equity_supply_constraint_source_qualification_v1/旧利率分解复用核对.json',
]
freeze={'registered_at':stamp,'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'before_new_coupon_amounts':True,'before_new_stock_returns_or_score':True,
 'input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in inputs},
 'authority_config_snapshots':{rel:json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for rel in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']}}
(directory/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'实验':protocol['study_id'],'状态':'固定月份来源实验已登记','新增拟合':0,'新增账户':0},ensure_ascii=False))
